title: Balanced matching decomposition of a bipartite graph
statement:
Let $G$ be a finite bipartite graph with edge set $E$ of size $\varepsilon = |E|$ and maximum degree $\Delta$, and let $p$ be a positive integer with $\Delta \le p$. Then there exist $p$ matchings $M_1, M_2, \ldots, M_p$ of $G$ that are pairwise edge-disjoint and satisfy
\[ E = M_1 \cup M_2 \cup \cdots \cup M_p, \]
with each of their sizes controlled by
\[ \left\lfloor \varepsilon/p \right\rfloor \le |M_i| \le \left\lceil \varepsilon/p \right\rceil \qquad (1 \le i \le p); \]
in particular, any two of the matchings differ in size by at most one.
hypotheses_covered: G is a finite graph (Fintype V, DecidableEq V)
maximum degree of G is at most p
